description: Defines the NtlmBufferWriter class for bounds-checked buffer operations in NTLM protocol implementation, including methods for writing various data types, security buffers, and NTLM message components.

classes.name: NtlmBufferWriter
classes.description: A class providing bounds-checked sequential write operations to an internal buffer for NTLM message construction.

methods.name: NtlmBufferWriter
methods.description: Constructor that allocates internal buffer of specified size.

methods.name: GetLength
methods.description: Returns the total size of the internal buffer.

methods.name: GetCursor
methods.description: Returns the current cursor position in the buffer.

methods.name: IsEndOfBuffer
methods.description: Checks if the cursor has reached or exceeded the buffer length.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Returns a read-only span of the internal buffer.

methods.name: Pass
methods.description: Returns ownership of the internal buffer as a vector.

methods.name: CanWrite
methods.description: Checks if there is enough space to write a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: WriteUInt16
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit unsigned integer in little-endian format.

methods.name: WriteUInt32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit unsigned integer in little-endian format.

methods.name: WriteUInt64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit unsigned integer in little-endian format.

methods.name: WriteFlags
methods.description: Writes negotiate flags as a 32-bit unsigned value.

methods.name: WriteBytes
methods.description: Writes a span of bytes into the buffer.

methods.name: WriteZeros
methods.description: Writes a specified number of zero bytes.

methods.name: WriteSecurityBuffer
methods.description: Writes an 8-byte security buffer structure.

methods.name: WriteAvPairHeader
methods.description: Writes an AV pair header with identifier and length.

methods.name: WriteAvPairTerminator
methods.description: Writes a zero-length AV pair to signal end of list.

methods.name: WriteAvPair
methods.description: Writes an AV pair header and payload.

methods.name: WriteUtf8String
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit character string.

methods.name: WriteUtf16AsUtf8String
methods.description: Converts UTF-16 string to UTF-8 and writes it.

methods.name: WriteUtf8AsUtf16String
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 string to UTF-16 LE and writes it.

methods.name: WriteUtf16String
methods.description: Writes a UTF-16 LE string.

methods.name: WriteSignature
methods.description: Writes the NTLM signature 'NTLMSSP\0'.

methods.name: WriteMessageType
methods.description: Writes the message type as a uint32.

methods.name: WriteMessageHeader
methods.description: Writes NTLM message signature and type.

methods.name: WriteUInt
methods.description: Template method to write integer types in little-endian.

methods.name: SetCursor
methods.description: Sets the cursor position in the buffer.

methods.name: AdvanceCursor
methods.description: Advances the cursor by a specified count.
